title: Recursive pass — Palantir / WEF Data Equity output-network closure depth 5
summary: Closes the five-depth Palantir / WEF Data Equity root at the evidence ceiling, preserving direct Hsiao participation while rejecting unsupported employer-level influence claims, and emits a separate temporal council-chronology root.

sources.title: Data Equity:Foundational Concepts for Generative AI

data.research_question: What survives as directly evidenced at the root's configured maximum depth?
data.method: Synthesize the report pair and person profile, then separate verified edges from unsupported institutional interpretations.
classification_rules: Person participation is not employer institutional authorship.
Repeated council membership is a temporal person-level fact, not proof of institutional control.
Search misses are coverage gaps rather than exhaustive absence claims.
A max-depth continuation must be emitted as a distinct new root.

findings.finding: Hsiao is directly tied to the 2023 and 2024 WEF Data Equity outputs while contemporaneously identified as a Palantir executive.
No reviewed source supports Palantir corporate authorship, sponsorship, control or policy-adoption claims.
The remaining high-value question is temporal:Data Policy council service versus Data Equity council service.
